An application was moved for release of the said motorcycle, however, the same was rejected only on the ground that the chassis number did not match with the seizure memo.
After going through the record, it appears that the registration number of the Hero Splendor+ is MH-40-BZ-0679.

The other details insofar as Chassis number is concerned, is MBLHAW090KHL83959 and Engine number is HA10AGKHLC7090.
4.

As could be gathered from the record,
one alphabet and one digit in the seizure memo were wrongly mentioned as "MALHAW090KHL83958".
In fact, the chassis number was wrongly recorded by the investigating agency while effecting the seizure panchanama.

Upon perusal of the tax invoices,
insurance policy, and the registration certificate issued by the Regional Transport Office, Nagpur (Rural), it appears that all other particulars match with the seizure memo, except one alphabet, i.e., "A"
and one digit, i.e., "8".
 3 12-Cr.WP-1049-2025 5. Considering the above facts, the Special Court has miserably failed to take into consideration the other details of the said vehicle.

From the record,
it appears that the petitioner is the owner of the said vehicle bearing registration number MH-40-BZ-0679.
The chassis number is MBLHAW090KHL83959 and the engine number is HA10AGKHLC7090.
Merely because the Investigating Agency has wrongly mentioned the Chasis number, that too, one alphabet and one digit, by itself, is not a valid reason to reject the application of the petitioner.

6. Considering the above facts and circumstances, I am of the view that, at the most, the Trial Court ought to have directed the Investigating Agency to re-verify the Chassis number, however, by straightway rejecting the application the petitioner has been deprived of his valuable right to get back his motorcycle being the owner.
Considering the above facts and circumstances, following order is passed:-
